evidence.claim: Plex's policy explains how it collects, uses and shares personal data and how users can control it.

Plex says some disclosures to third parties may constitute a 'sale' or 'sharing' (including for cross-context behavioral advertising) of personal information, and that data for managed accounts is not sold or shared with third-party advertisers.
For its website, Plex says optional analytics cookies use Google and Facebook analytics.
Users can exercise a right to opt out of sharing personal data for targeted advertising or of its sale.
After identity verification Plex says it will delete personal data associated with the account, except archived copies it may retain as required by law.
Plex says some disclosures to third parties may count as a sale or sharing for advertising purposes, offers an opt-out, and will delete account data on request (except legally required archives).

Exodus Privacy static analysis of version 2026.18.1 (report dated Sept. 23, 2026) found code signatures for 2 known tracker SDK(s): fullstory (analytics), Sentry (crash reporting). A signature shows the SDK is present, not what data it sends.
